description: Type text into an input field identified by its ref ID. Clears the field first, then types the new text. Requires browser_navigate and browser_snapshot to be called first. Vault: on a login, checkout or 2FA form, call browser_vault through tool_call (action=list first) for saved credentials. If the vault has no item for this site and the user has directly provided a password or one-time code (e.g. read from email or messages), you may type it with this tool — typed values are auto-redacted from results and history so they never leak to chat. Never guess credentials. Never type card numbers, CVCs, or other payment data — use the vault's payment fill instead.
name: browser_type

ref.description: The element reference from the snapshot (e.g., '@e3')

text.description: The text to type into the field
